page: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-288-lssd is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor. It features 288 dedicated vCPUs across 144 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The system is equipped with 2232.0 GB of RAM, providing 7.75 GB of memory per vCPU. Local storage is bundled, consisting of 48 local NVMe SSDs totaling 19031 GB of capacity. No GPUs are included in this configuration.

Benchmark data shows top-tier performance in multi-core CPU execution, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 312066.06 and a PassMark CPU score of 176285.93. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, achieving top-tier status in both small-block cached reads at 22962.94 GB/sec and large-block uncached reads at 1060.25 GB/sec. Database operations and key-value store throughput are also in the top tier, with Redis SET operations reaching 390.97 million operations per second.

While multi-threaded and memory-intensive tasks perform in the top tier, single-core performance presents a relative tradeoff; stress-ng single-core CPU performance falls into the average category. Additionally, LLM inference text generation speeds vary, showing weak performance for small 135M models at 59.17 tokens/sec but rising to strong for medium 7B models. Given the massive local NVMe storage and high memory capacity, this server is configured for memory-intensive databases, large-scale data processing, and highly parallelized workloads.
